source:
Maeve, Veda, Winnie, Mina, and Felicity are all incoming freshman this year at North East High School. Each girl has lived her whole life feeling isolated from her peers, having her own unique reasons for struggling to connect with those around her. However, this year, they will all discover that the empathy these experiences have granted them may be far more valuable than they ever could have imagined.

梅芙、维达、温妮、米娜和费莉西蒂都是今年东北高中的新生。每个女孩一生都感到与同龄人孤立，有自己独特的原因难以与周围的人建立联系。然而，今年，他们都会发现这些经历赋予他们的同理心可能比他们想象的更有价值。
